Statement._comment: Gates use of a Bedrock API key at all, independent of InvokeModel. Must be Resource:* - it authorises the authentication method, not a model, so it cannot be scoped by resource. Which models the key can actually reach is still constrained by the InvokeModel statements below.

Third-party models on Bedrock (OpenAI, Qwen) are brokered through AWS Marketplace, so the calling principal must be able to SEE the account's subscription. Deliberately excludes aws-marketplace:Subscribe: that would let this key subscribe the account to any Marketplace product and incur charges. The subscription itself is established once by an admin.
